source.instrument: LeCroy WavePro 740Zi JitterKit, 0.5 ms records at 40 GS/s; Keysight DSO9104A simultaneous cross-check
source.device: external clock reference PC281 'Ext Clock Ref V1.0', 100 MHz, +6 dBm and +10 dBm outputs, after >= 5 min oven warm-up

caveats: Floor-limited: the oscilloscope's own timing noise dominates both measurements, so every jitter and Allan-deviation number here is an upper bound on the clock, not its value. The datasheet figures (63.6 fs integrated, sigma_y(1 s) = 2e-11) sit far below this floor and are not measured here.
0.5 ms records reach tau ~ 0.1 ms: the Allan deviation shows only the white-PM (tau^-1) branch. The spec point at 1 s is a datasheet value, drawn for scale.
The integrated jitter is sqrt(integral of S_x) over the band chosen, as in the reduction; the default 12 kHz - 20 MHz band is the datasheet's.
